name: Homosexuality
overview: Scripture clearly defines homosexuality as contrary to God's design for human relationships, affirming that God created humanity as male and female from the beginning (Mark 10:6). The Old Testament explicitly condemns same-sex relations as an abomination deserving severe judgment (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13). The New Testament echoes this by describing homosexual behavior as a departure from natural use and a consequence of turning away from God (Romans 1:26-27). The account of Sodom (Genesis 19:1) further illustrates the moral corruption associated with such practices.
